errors.claim: Places Where Women MATCH Men at Work
errors.reason: The indicator is a female-to-male ratio expressed in percentage (e.g., Moldova is 100.1%), not women matching men one-to-one in absolute worker counts.

Nigeria's value is 95.73% and Iraq's is 15.07%; 95.73 / 15.07 is approximately 6.35 times, but rounding or exact checks should be verified. Wait, 95.7329 / 15.0691 is 6.3529, so 6.4 is a slight rounding discrepancy or unsupported multiplier depending on precision.

claims.text: In Moldova, female economic activity matches men at 100%, while Afghanistan sits at 7%.
claims.support: Moldova value is 100.123% (display 100%), Afghanistan value is 7.29% (display 7%).

claims.text: It counts everyone ages 15 and older who supplies labor for goods and services.
claims.support: Definition: Labor force participation rate is the proportion of the population ages 15 and older that is economically active: all people who supply labor for the production of goods and services during a specified period.
Nigeria value is 95.73% (display 96%), Iraq value is 15.07% (display 15%).

claims.text: The lowest rates on Earth cluster in Afghanistan at 7%, Yemen at 8%, and Iraq at 15%.
claims.support: Afghanistan rank 184 (7.29%), Yemen rank 183 (7.62%, display 8%), Iraq rank 182 (15.07%, display 15%).
